proposed_intervals.note: start = signing date (order states no effective date); end = signing date of EO 12553, which states no later effective date

rationale: EO 11350 (32 FR 6961, May 3, 1967) amends the Selective Service Regulations (32 CFR ch. XVI) under the Universal Military Training and Service Act, with its own retention provision for forms until induction (an until-event for records, not an end of the order). It was amended by EO 11360 (June 30, 1967) and EO 11586 (March 10, 1971); amendments are later events, not ends. EO 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, held text) orders that listed Executive Orders, "and any amendments thereto, are revoked", and its list includes the line "11350 Amending Selective Service regulations" (also 11360, 11586, 11606 among the amenders). The revocation is whole-order, has no savings clause and no later effective date, so no part survives; the 1989 OFR snapshot is a lead only. Not in effect on 2026-10-14.
